items.l1-u01-d1: Are you at the school door?
items.l1-u01-d7: Do you want a red pen or a blue pen?
items.l1-u02-d1: What is in that big box?
items.l1-u02-d7: Can you say, "Happy birthday" with us?
items.l1-u03-d1: How many kids are on your team?
items.l1-u03-d7: Can two new kids play with us?
items.l1-u04-d1: What is wrong with your arm?
items.l1-u04-d7: Can you see with this eye?
items.l1-u05-d1: Is that your dog by the tree?
items.l1-u05-d3: Why is your cat up there?
items.l1-u05-d5: Is the bird near the sun?
items.l1-u06-d1: What do you want for lunch?
items.l1-u06-d3: Do you want milk or tea?
items.l1-u06-d5: Yes, and the water is here.
items.l1-u06-d7: Yes, but eat your food first.
items.l1-u07-d1: Do you go home by bus?
items.l1-u07-d3: Can you come to the park first?
items.l1-u08-d1: Is that your new red bike?
items.l1-u08-d7: Do you want to walk there now?
items.l2-u01-d1: Please put these cups on the table.
items.l2-u01-d3: Put them under the birthday sign.
items.l2-u01-d5: Yes, and its color is pink.
items.l2-u02-d7: Can every student join the song?
items.l2-u03-d1: What animal is near the flower?
items.l2-u03-d3: Can you see the fox, too?
items.l2-u03-d7: Do you want to draw this zoo?
items.l2-u04-d1: Do you want cake or candy?
items.l2-u04-d5: What does Dad want to eat?
items.l2-u05-d1: Please close your book. Lunch is ready.
items.l2-u05-d7: Yes, and give me your bowl first.
items.l2-u06-d3: Do you want the green shirt?
items.l2-u06-d5: How about this cute pink one?
items.l2-u06-d7: The gray one looks friendly and clean.
items.l2-u07-d1: Hi! Can I sit here for the picnic?
items.l2-u07-d3: Oh, I can sit by the yellow bag.
items.l2-u07-d5: Wow, it looks nice on you.
items.l2-u07-d7: Do you want to sing our song?
items.l3-u01-d1: When should we meet for our English project?
items.l3-u01-d3: I have music class then. Can we meet in the afternoon?
items.l3-u01-d5: Let's use the table by the window.
items.l3-u01-d7: Why don't we bring our word cards too?
items.l3-u02-d1: Dad, what time does the family picnic start?
items.l3-u02-d3: Are Aunt May and Uncle Sam coming?
items.l3-u02-d5: Can I invite my friend Leo too?
items.l3-u02-d7: Great! I will call him before eight p.m.
items.l3-u03-d1: Look at that duck near the pond!
items.l3-u03-d3: Do you think the animal is hungry?
items.l3-u03-d5: The weather is getting windy now.
items.l3-u03-d7: Can we fly our kite before we leave?
items.l3-u04-d1: What are we making in cooking class today?
items.l3-u04-d3: Can I open it on the computer?
items.l3-u04-d5: How do you spell the last word?
items.l3-u04-d7: The teacher can help us after she checks the drinks.
items.l3-u05-d1: What should we take to the picnic?
items.l3-u05-d3: Can we bring ice cream too?
items.l3-u05-d5: Then I will put some ice in this box.
items.l3-u05-d7: Should I call Amy on the phone?
items.l3-u06-d1: How are we getting to the beach for our trip?
items.l3-u06-d3: Can we bring our bikes on it?
items.l3-u06-d5: My dad could drive us in his car instead.
items.l3-u06-d7: Then I will call him and choose the train.
items.l3-u07-d1: Do you want to join our soccer practice?
items.l3-u07-d3: I can work with you after school.
items.l3-u07-d5: Sure. We can make two small teams.
items.l3-u07-d7: Okay. I will take the ball home today.
items.l3-u08-d1: Oops, I dropped all the colored paper.
items.l3-u08-d3: Are there any more down there?
items.l3-u08-d5: Really? Then let's put them up on the shelf.
items.l3-u08-d7: Thanks. I have to go now. Goodbye!
items.l4-u01-d1: Does this calendar show the sports day?
items.l4-u01-d5: Can you speak to the teacher about it?
items.l4-u01-d7: Good, because fifteen students need to know soon.
items.l4-u02-d1: Is our basketball score still thirteen?
items.l4-u02-d3: The other team has sixteen, right?
items.l4-u02-d5: Do you think we can reach twenty?
items.l4-u02-d7: Look, Mia scored! We have seventeen now.
items.l4-u03-d1: Are we visiting Grandpa this weekend?
items.l4-u03-d3: Will Grandma make lunch for us?
items.l4-u03-d5: Great. Can we bring the panda puzzle?
items.l4-u03-d7: I may get thirsty on the long bus ride.
items.l4-u04-d1: Did you see my pencil case in the bookstore?
items.l4-u04-d3: Yes. My crayons and pencil are inside.
items.l4-u04-d5: Was it under the alphabet book?
items.l4-u04-d7: Thanks! I need it for my homework.
items.l4-u05-d1: Do you want pork or steak for dinner?
items.l4-u05-d3: Would you like salad with it?
items.l4-u05-d5: Are you saving room for a snack?
items.l4-u05-d7: I think it has too much sugar.
items.l4-u06-d1: Are we near the station now?
items.l4-u06-d3: Which road leads to the restaurant?
items.l4-u06-d5: Is it next to the tall wall?
items.l4-u06-d7: I see it through that big window.
items.l4-u07-d1: Can I stop at the shallow end today?
items.l4-u07-d3: I fell yesterday, so I still worry.
items.l4-u07-d5: Should I stay close to you?
items.l4-u07-d7: I'll try my best on the next lap.
items.l4-u08-d1: Which paper bridge is the strongest?
items.l4-u08-d5: Yes, but one side looks funny now.
items.l4-u08-d7: Your folded design is very smart.
items.l4-u09-d1: What should we do on this rainy vacation day?
items.l4-u09-d3: Is that the one about a summer soccer team?
items.l4-u09-d5: Can we play my dancing CD first?
items.l4-u09-d7: Winter is the best season for staying inside.
items.l4-u10-d1: Where is the kitten for our Chinese New Year photo?
items.l4-u10-d5: Maybe it doesn't like the drum sound.
items.l4-u10-d7: Then let's finish the family part first.
